help.title: Quick Start for 芯宏Skills仓库
help.description: Fastest path: Skills Plaza → My Skills → Global/Project Workspace. Press ⌘K anytime for the command palette.

workflows.title: Recommended Workflows
workflows.description: Single-agent: install from Skills Plaza → manage in My Skills → click a set pill in Global Workspace to add all at once. Multi-project: create a "Project · name" set per repo and add bound skills from Project Workspace. Multi-machine: enable Git Backup in Settings.

skillLevels.title: Three Skill Scopes
skillLevels.description: Classified by who owns them and where they apply. Filter by scope in My Skills, or change scope in a skill's detail panel. Skills Plaza is for acquisition — label scope after install, then sync.

examples.personal: Personal — cross-project skills you keep for yourself, e.g. coding habits, Git conventions, debugging workflows. Default for new installs; sync via Global Workspace to all projects on this machine.
examples.org: Organization — team-wide standards, e.g. company code rules, security checklists, shared domain knowledge. Today: share a Git remote and mark skills as Organization.
examples.project: Project — tied to one repo only, e.g. this app's architecture, business rules, deploy steps. Managed in Project Workspaces; imports from a project are auto-labeled Project.

skillLevels.hint: Quick pick: company-wide rule → Organization; repo-specific → Project; everything else cross-project → Personal.

presets.title: Skill Sets
presets.description: When a project needs several skill types (e.g. code standards + architecture + deploy runbooks), bind them into a named set. In a project or global workspace, click the set pill to add every skill to the current agent at once instead of one by one. Active sets show ✓. This is a one-time apply — not live sync.

install.title: Skills Plaza
install.description: Import from local folders, Git repositories, archives, or the marketplace. Batch-import multiple skills from a folder at once.

sync.title: My Skills
sync.description: Browse all installed skills with bulk tag editing and per-agent sync toggles. Filter by source or tag — including an Untagged pill to surface skills missing labels. Click an agent icon on any skill card to install or remove that skill for that agent in one click; the always-visible delete button removes a skill from the central library. Click the card itself to view docs, version history, and agent sync details.

global.title: Global Workspace
global.description: Each agent gets its own page listing every skill in its global folder — including ones installed outside this app — so the view matches what the agent actually sees. Use + Add Skills to pull from your central library with inline target-agent chips, or use the All Agents overview to manage every installed agent at once. Skills that only exist in an agent folder can be deleted directly from the card.

projects.title: Project Workspaces
projects.description: Link a project to browse per-agent local skill folders, compare with the central library, and import or export changes. Use set pills to add bound skills to the project at once, or open + Add Skills to pick from your library with a multi-agent target picker.

backup.title: Git Backup
backup.description: Configure a remote repository in Settings, then back up or sync from My Skills. Each sync creates a restorable snapshot tag — ideal for multi-machine sync and version tracking.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage agent paths and toggles, add custom agents, drag to reorder how agents appear across the app, change sync mode, theme, text size, language, proxy, Git remote, AI search key, and check for app updates. Use Export Logs to bundle recent logs and install/remove/update/sync activity into a single zip when filing an issue.
